restoration_note: The teaching presents one triad (Goodness/Wisdom/Power) at three discrete degrees: Father → cosmos of aeons → elements. Most restorations are constrained by (a) the explicit triadic formula 'Eudaimonia/Sophia/Power = X', (b) cross-register parallels within the chapter (esp. §119 mirroring §114), and (c) the lexicon's stable titles (Living Spirit, Pillar of Glory, Five Sons of First Man, Virgin of Light). I confirmed editor proposals where formula and grammar agreed. I overrode {72}: editor's 'Five Sons' contradicts the spiritual reading, which clearly identifies Sophia at element level as the Living Spirit (with Five Sons appearing on next line as Power). I marked unrestorable the broad opening descriptors of worldly Eudaimonia (§§91-94), the long isolated lines (§§107-108), and lines where partial traces give too little anchor (§§101-102 verb of descent, §117 fragmented opening). Where parallel passages constrained the fill (§114 mirroring §119; §125 echoing the Pillar→Perfect Man identification), confidence is high.
